# PKCS #11 fixture headers

Unmodified OASIS headers from [oasis-tcs/pkcs11](https://github.com/oasis-tcs/pkcs11/tree/9ef73f9f44ed8a240b05484427a0851ab36be251/published), commit `9ef73f9f44ed8a240b05484427a0851ab36be251`.

- `2.40`: `published/2-40-errata-1`.
- `3.0`: `published/3-00-errata-1` (corrected headers).
- `3.1`: `published/3-01`.
- `3.2`: `published/3-02`.

Copyright and license notices are retained in each header. Used only to compile
native function-table fixtures; production bindings come from `cryptoki-sys`.
